details:
* SECURITY UPDATE: DoS / symlink attack via the attacker-precreatable
     pivot_root mount point
     - debian/patches/CVE-2019-12439.patch: mount the root tmpfs on /tmp itself
       in main() (bubblewrap.c) instead of creating /run/user/$UID/.bubblewrap
       or /tmp/.bubblewrap-$UID, which another local user can pre-create as a
       non-directory or as a symlink they control
     - debian/patches/CVE-2019-12439-test.patch: upstream regression test for
       the above, asserting the pivot_root scaffolding (/tmp/oldroot,
       /tmp/newroot) stays invisible inside the container (tests/test-run.sh)
     - CVE-2019-12439
